title: TFI International reports US$105.7M Q3 profit, up from US$84.7M last year
text: TFI International reports US$105.7M Q3 profit, up from US$84.7M last year MONTREAL — TFI International Inc. reported its net income rose to US$105.7 million in the third quarter from US$84.7 million a year earlier. Thu, October 29, 2026 at 11:58 p.m. GMT+2TFI International logo is seen in this undated photo. THE CANADIAN PRESS\/HO, TFI *MANDATORY CREDIT* - The Canadian Press MONTREAL — TFI International Inc. reported its net income rose to US$105.7 million in the third quarter from US$84.7 million a year earlier. On a diluted per-share basis, its earnings amounted to US$1.28, compared with US$1.02 in the prior-year quarter. The Montreal-based trucking firm, which keeps its books in U.S. dollars, says its revenue reached US$2.23 billion during the period, rising year-over-year from US$1.97 billion. The company says total revenue in its logistics segment rose 22 per cent and 15 per cent for its truckload segment.TFI International also declared a quarterly dividend in September of 47 cents US, rising four per cent from last year. Alain Bédard, TFI International's CEO, says in a news release that the company has now produced US$440 million year-to-date in free cash flow. Companies in this story:
